meta.chiitoi_tenpai: 6 distinct pairs + 1 single tile (7 DISTINCT types x 2). The rule 'one odd count in {1,3}' of MODEL.md section 5 is wrong: a 3- or 4-count tile can never become a pair of a seven-pairs hand.
meta.mincount_criterion: a common k-code exists for a class iff sum_t min_{H in class} H[t] >= k
meta.buckets: hands are count vectors over the sector types, written as a digit string

totals.note: chiitoi classes are enumerated by census_two.py into out/global.json
